title: nonlinear dense softmax Mirror expert mixture
hypothesis: For a dense softmax MoE teacher with nonlinear expert functions related by per-role Givens coordinates, a shared FFN plus four charged Mirror views recovers the full probability-weighted output at lower serialized bytes than untied MoE and beats hard tying plus byte-near FiLM/rank-2 residual controls; independent roles require private weights.
scope_delta: Unlike MA-001/002 sparse top-k, every expert is evaluated for every example and contributes via learned softmax. Unlike MA-005, roles are nonlinear and router-weighted, not linear and fixed signed coefficients.
mirror_coordinate: four learned four-angle Givens codes on the 16D input/output, one per role
logical_multiplicity: four router-addressable nonlinear roles, all four composed per example
controls: full soft MoE with rank-2 factorized router
tied expert plus per-role hidden FiLM
tied expert plus per-role rank-2 output residual
tied expert plus per-role Mirror Givens views

teacher.router: frozen seeded linear 16x4 teacher; full softmax probabilities mix all four expert outputs and are targets for student router distillation
teacher.aligned: one frozen nonlinear FFN conjugated by independent per-role Givens views
teacher.independent: four independently initialized frozen nonlinear FFNs
teacher.samples: standard normal 16D inputs; independent train/validation/test streams by world seed

task.mixture: full softmax over all four roles
task.structure_audit: dominant-role router accuracy, router KL, per-dominant-role MSE

development.selection_metric: arithmetic mean held-out MSE across all methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At the selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x dense untied full-soft MoE MSE and Mirror payload <=0.65x full-soft MoE payload; otherwise mark FAIL and keep fresh sealed.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save complete CPU state dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

gates.development_open_fresh: At selected LR aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x dense untied and actual payload <=0.65x dense untied; else FAIL with fresh sealed.
gates.fresh_useful_sharing_pass: All three aligned fresh worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x dense untied, dominant-role accuracy within 1 percentage point of dense untied, and payload <=0.65x dense untied.
gates.mirror_specific: All three aligned fresh worlds: Mirror MSE at least 10% lower than hard tying, FiLM, and rank-2 residual; payload no larger than each and active MAC plus coordinate proxy <=1.10x each.
gates.fail: Development gate fails; or fresh useful-sharing misses in at least two worlds; or simple control is within 10% MSE at equal/lower bytes and <=1.10x active compute in at least two worlds.
gates.promising: Fresh useful-sharing passes at least 2/3, or passes 3/3 while Mirror-specific gate misses due an identified simpler-control/storage/runtime tradeoff.
gates.not_established: Invalid/missing worlds, split leak, nondeterministic serialization, or unreproducible results.

boundaries: synthetic nonlinear dense soft mixture only
aligned teacher deliberately favors Givens views
fixed updates are not near-convergence capacity evidence
all four roles active; no sparse-compute claim
independent teacher tests one private-parameter boundary
no language-model, optimized GPU or path-routing claim
